title: N Queens
prompt: The n-queens puzzle is the problem of placing n queens on an n x n chessboard such that no two queens attack each other. Given an integer n, return all distinct solutions to the n-queens puzzle. Each solution contains a distinct board configuration of the n-queens' placement where 'Q' and '.' both indicate a queen and an empty space, respectively. You may return the answer in any order.
hints: Place one queen per row. Track columns used and diagonals (row-col and row+col).
Backtrack: for row r, try each col c. If col and both diagonals are free, place queen, recurse row r+1, remove.
cols: set of used cols. diag1: row-col (constant for each anti-diagonal). diag2: row+col (constant for each diagonal).
